meta.name: ad-creative
meta.description: When the user needs to generate, iterate, or scale ad creative for paid advertising. Use when they say 'write ad copy,' 'generate headlines,' 'create ad variations,' 'bulk creative,' 'iterate on ads,' 'ad copy validation,' 'RSA headlines,' 'Meta ad copy,' 'LinkedIn ad,' or 'creative testing.' This is pure creative production — distinct from paid-ads (campaign strategy). Use ad-creative when you need the copy, not the campaign plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成和迭代广告文案与创意变体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为付费广告生成或优化文案和创意。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and iterate ad copy and creative variations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate or optimize ad copy and creative for paid advertising.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成广告文案专家，能生成、迭代或批量制作付费广告的文案，包括标题、正文和变体，并检查是否符合平台规则。
howto.when: 当你要求“写广告文案”、“生成标题”、“创建广告变体”、“批量创意”、“迭代广告”、“验证广告文案”、“RSA 标题”、“Meta 广告文案”、“LinkedIn 广告”或“创意测试”时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一组 Google RSA 广告标题，每个不超过30字。
say.note: Claude 会生成15个标题并按公式类型分组。

say.text: 基于这个获胜广告，迭代5个变体并测试2个新角度。
say.note: Claude 会分析获胜模式并生成变体。

say.text: 为我的 Meta 广告验证文案，检查字符限制和拒绝风险。
say.note: Claude 会逐行验证并给出质量评分。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude becomes an ad copy expert that can generate, iterate, or scale paid ad creative, including headlines, body copy, and variations, and validate them against platform specs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'write ad copy,' 'generate headlines,' 'create ad variations,' 'bulk creative,' 'iterate on ads,' 'ad copy validation,' 'RSA headlines,' 'Meta ad copy,' 'LinkedIn ad,' or 'creative testing.'

say_en.text: Write a set of Google RSA headlines, each under 30 characters.
say_en.note: Claude will generate 15 headlines grouped by formula type.

say_en.text: Iterate on this winning ad: create 5 variations and test 2 new angles.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the winning pattern and generate variations.

say_en.text: Validate my Meta ad copy for character limits and rejection risks.
say_en.note: Claude will line-by-line validate and give a quality score.
